remarks: Looking for a terrific investment? Or want a way to live in one unit, and rent out the other? Here is a great opportunity to own a large two-family home in a great location in Stamford! Each unit has been remodeled and updated, offering a great floor plan in both. 2 bedrooms, 1 bath. But unit 2 has many options with a 3rd floor JUST being finished, adding an additional 800 square feet, for total living space of over 2000 square feet. Each unit also has their own washer and dryer. There is a large grassy, fenced in backyard, to relax, play, etc. Plus an oversized front deck in front to hang out with friends and people watch. A huge added feature is the 2 car garage, and even bigger is the proximity to the train station; Springdale Train Station is directly across the street. So if you commute, or any of your future tenants do - it really couldn't get any better than this. Set your appointment now, before this one is GONE!
